title: Uniform Confidence Bands for Proximal Dose-Response Curves with Selected Bandwidths and Estimated Covariance
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded incremental below the field floor (paper-score ceiling 6.2 < 7.4), with no bounded in-scope salvage; math-panel findings remain unresolved, so soundness is unverified.

proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed the pooled covariance and selected-band proof program, then F2 compiled a Lean scaffold with placeholders. F2.5 exposed a false marginal-risk transfer; D0 repaired it by adding explicit dose-density overlap and later corrected the cited rectangle CLT scope. Fresh D0.5 review graded the narrowed result incremental below the fixed field floor, and its remaining math-panel findings were not repaired; this archive is not a certified theorem.
tldr: The source-faithful fixed-grid construction controls every estimator remainder on the mesh index \(\mathcal I_n\), including the same-fold term at order \(O_P\{(nh_{\min})^{-1}\}\); the final continuum band follows from the separate interpolation and bias argument. The original \(n^{-1/5}\) band remains valid and has expected supremum width \(O\{\sqrt{\log(1/h_{\min})/(nh_{\min})}\}\). A separate bias-aware procedure adds an explicit common Holder radius and uses \(\bar h_n=(\log n/n)^{1/(5+2\beta)}\), giving selector-uniform coverage and expected supremum width \(O\{(\log n/n)^{(2+\beta)/(5+2\beta)}\}\). An explicit bounded random-design causal regression embedding and localized-bump Fano argument give the matching honest-band lower bound; the bump/testing paradigm and classical logarithmic exponent are inherited, while the proximal causal embedding and match to the feasible fallback-aware upper band are the contribution.
gap: Ham--Wu--Cui prove an oracle population-covariance band for one deterministic bandwidth pair and leave validity of the equation~11 empirical covariance open.  Their implementation distinguishes the equation~9 raw score from the equation~10 centered score, and no theorem validates that centered covariance jointly over bandwidths or after selection.  Their bridge identity is naturally an almost-everywhere statement, and neither the source nor the adjacent covariance literature supplies the continuous-version bookkeeping, explicit fallback-probability rate, or primitive finite-proxy learner guarantee required by a total uniform band.
fill: The main results fix continuous dose versions on \(\mathcal A_\delta\), derive pointwise identification from the almost-everywhere bridge identity, condition on an explicit cross-fitted localized-risk input, prove the common-constant six-remainder linearization, and compare the joint Gram covariance of the equation~10 centered scores with its population target before calibrating over the dose-by-bandwidth index.  A separate proposition bounds \(P(\mathcal F_n)\) by \(C_F\{r_n^2+(nh_{\min})^{-1}\}+C_Dn^{-D}+C_Ee^{-c_Enh_{\min}}\).  The finite-proxy route uses the corrected right-hand side \(f_{A,P}(a)\rho_P(a,x)\) and attains squared rate \(O((\log n/n)^{4/5})\) under explicitly maintained uniform finite-cell positivity and smoothness conditions for a fixed categorical-proxy regime.
